# War Library

> Open-source, real-time tracker of conflict events, starting with the 2026 US-Israel war on Iran (Operation Epic Fury). Every event is extracted from a named news report and carries its source link, a confidence score, a verification status and a location precision. Run by Mid-Atlantic AI LLC. Code: https://github.com/midatlanticAI/WarLibrary

## What the data is

- Events: dated, geocoded records with an event type (airstrike, missile_attack, drone_attack, battle, explosion, violence_against_civilians, strategic_development, protest), a description, actors, fatalities as reported, country and region.
- Kinetic events (strikes, attacks, battles, violence against civilians) are the headline count and the map default. Strategic developments (statements, deployments, sanctions, diplomacy) are kept as a separate stream.
- Verification: confirmed (multiple outlets), reported (one outlet), claimed (a party to the conflict), disputed, unconfirmed.
- Location precision: exact, city, region, country (centroid). Country-centroid events are approximate placements.
- Fatalities are per-event figures as each source reported them and are not de-duplicated across reports of the same incident.
- Updated every 30 minutes by an automated pipeline; the pipeline's current stats are at /api/health.

## Pages

- Map and feed: https://warlibrary.midatlantic.ai/
- Countries, ranked by activity: https://warlibrary.midatlantic.ai/country
- One country: https://warlibrary.midatlantic.ai/country/{slug} (for example /country/iran, /country/yemen)
- One event: https://warlibrary.midatlantic.ai/event/{id}
- Sources and verification method: https://warlibrary.midatlantic.ai/sources
- About: https://warlibrary.midatlantic.ai/about
- RSS of latest verified kinetic events: https://warlibrary.midatlantic.ai/feed.xml
- Sitemap index: https://warlibrary.midatlantic.ai/sitemap.xml

## API (JSON, no key, MIT-licensed data)

- Everything: https://warlibrary.midatlantic.ai/api/events (large; about 30 MB uncompressed; supports ETag / If-None-Match)
- Aggregates only: https://warlibrary.midatlantic.ai/api/events?summary=1
- Date window: https://warlibrary.midatlantic.ai/api/events?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD
- Paging: &limit=N&offset=M ; narrative fields dropped: &fields=lite
- One event with nearby events: https://warlibrary.midatlantic.ai/api/events/{id}
- Pipeline health and last-run stats: https://warlibrary.midatlantic.ai/api/health

## Citing

Cite the event page URL and the source it links to. Treat figures as "as reported" and check the verification status and location precision before relying on a number or a coordinate.
